Create soil input file for 3DCMCCFEM model

Source: R/make_soil_ISRIC.R
make_soil_ISRIC.Rd

make_soil_ISRIC use the soilGrids from the ISRIC database to create the soil input file according to the 3DCMCCFEM model specifications.

Usage

make_soil_ISRIC(
  plot,
  crs = NULL,
  buffer = 100,
  id = NULL,
  site = NULL,
  outdir = NULL,
  return_df = FALSE,
  isric_file = getOption("R3DFEM.isric_file", system.file("extdata", "ISRIC.tif", package
    = "R3DFEM"))
)

Arguments

plot

Sf object or something that can be converted to an sf point object (i.e., a data.frame of coordinates). If plot is a data.frame the first two colums must specify X and Y coordinates. if plot ia a data.frame the argument crs must be specified.

crs

Numeric: a valid EPSG code

buffer

Numeric: buffer around plot to extract meteo data from

id

Character: name of the column in plot that identifies different points

site

Character: the name of the plot site. Used to construct the output name

outdir

Character: path to the output directory.

return_df

Logical: should the climate data be returned by the function as a data.frame? Default to FALSE

isric_file

Character: path of the SoilGrids raster (ISRIC.tif, not distributed with the package). Default to the option R3DFEM.isric_file or, if not set, to the extdata directory of the installed package.

Value

Used for its side effects. It saves in outdir a file site_soil.txt. The most important columns in this file are:

  • X: x cell position

  • Y: y cell position

  • LANDUSE: "F" by default: Forest land use.

  • LAT: latitude of point

  • LON: longitude of point

  • CLAY_PERC: soil clay (in %)

  • SILT_PERC: soil silt (in %)

  • SAND_PERC: soil sand (in %)

  • SOIL_DEPTH: soil depth (in cm), 100 by default

  • FR:0.9 by default. Fertility rating (dim) (only LUE version)

  • FN0:0.5 by default. Value of fertility modifier when FR=0 (dim) (only LUE version)

  • M0:0.2 by default. Value of ‘m’ when FR=0 (dim) (only LUE version)

Details

This function compute the mean percentage of sand, silt and clay in the first meter of soil, weighted by the thickness of the SoilGrids layers (0-5, 5-15, 15-30, 30-60, 60-100 cm). The file is written with make_soil. For more information on soil file needed by the model please refer to the User's Guide

See also

make_soil, run_3DCMCCFEM
